Built natively for Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS, the platform enables organizations to ingest, transform, and deliver analytics-ready data at scale. Matillion achieved unicorn status in 2022 at a $1.5 billion valuation and serves thousands of enterprise customers including Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack. Summary It lists 501–1000 employees. It has raised $310.0M in total across 6 rounds, most recently a Venture Round in Nov 2022. Investors include Sapphire Ventures, Battery Ventures and YFM Equity Partners.
